items.html: Know, however, that only the phase of Nefesh within Nefesh of ZA has entered there so far, and therefore only the vessels of the portion of the Nefesh within Nefesh of ZA have been clarified. For according to what is clarified from the Nefesh, so is clarified from the vessel. Hence the stature of the body of the fetus is still very small, even though it is included of ten Sefirot and of its 248 organs, which are of the aspect of Nefesh within Nefesh, as above.
